memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent in ADLs, walks unaided, manages household chores.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (recall 3 items, clock draw normal), negative screen.
falls: no falls in last 12 months, gait steady, timed up-and-go 10 seconds (within normal).
medicines: 7 regular (amlodipine 5 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, losartan 50 mg OD, hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg OD, pantoprazole 40 mg OD, domperidone 10 mg BD, silymarin 140 mg TDS). Polypharmacy – request review against Beers criteria.
mood: reports good spirits, denies depression or anxiety.
carers: daughter Priya, provides weekly grocery assistance.
goals: "I want to stay active and continue my postal work part‑time as long as possible."
